title: TM-7 — live real-node run_task_lg vs run_task parity (durable-resume gate)

provenance.coordination_note: TM-7 code landed 2026-07-17 (checkpointing.py + run_task_lg_durable/resume_task_lg, AsyncSqliteSaver, crash+interrupt->Command(resume) proven 10/10 with STUB nodes). REMAINING GATED leg: live real-node run_task_lg parity vs run_task on a fixed task set BEFORE enabling interrupt-based review gates (H3). Hazard: node re-execution on resume — _execute_turn/REPL side effects must be idempotent. Imports scoped strictly to langgraph + langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite (minimum-imports).

preconditions.stack_lineup: production lineup for real-node execution; data/graph_checkpoints.sqlite present

execution.protocol_id: P-AB-1 (paired parity: run_task_lg vs run_task on a fixed task set)

outcomes.expected: run_task_lg reaches output parity with run_task on the fixed task set with idempotent resume (no duplicated REPL side effects), clearing the gate to enable interrupt-based review gates (H3).

gate_table.gate: Is run_task_lg at parity with run_task on real nodes, with idempotent resume?
gate_table.evidence: per-task output equivalence + resume side-effect audit (no duplicate _execute_turn/REPL effects), P-AB-1, seed 42

pass.rule: output parity on all fixed tasks AND clean idempotent resume
action: flip TM-7 remaining-gated + TM-8 coverage checkboxes; unblock H3 interrupt review gates

marginal.rule: parity holds but resume shows benign re-execution with no state corruption
action: record observation; keep interrupt gates OFF pending an idempotency fix

fail.rule: output divergence OR resume duplicates side effects / corrupts state
action: keep GENERALIZED_INTERRUPTS forbidden; document the idempotency hazard in checkpointing.py

infra.classify: checkpointer DB error / AsyncSqliteSaver failure / node crash unrelated to parity
action: verify data/graph_checkpoints.sqlite; re-run the parity set in a fresh quiet window
hold for operator; attach per-task diff + resume side-effect trace

ledger.journal_quarantine_rule: record task id, run_task vs run_task_lg output equivalence, resume side-effect count, seed; quarantine diagnostic_only if the fixed task set changed between arms.
